description: Lifecycle settings. Unrecognized keys are accepted with a warning. Configure pushes merge independently optional keys over the live settings. URL syntax, credential ambiguity and egress policy are additionally validated by the plugin at runtime.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL to POST hook envelopes to. HTTPS is required except for loopback HTTP sidecars; private, link-local, metadata and ambiguous or non-UTF-8 decoded credential URLs are refused by runtime validation. References are resolved by the host before lifecycle validation.

timeout_ms.description: Per-op timeout in milliseconds. Missing or null uses 5000 at open; supplied unsigned integer tokens are accepted and clamped to [1, 5000]. In configure pushes, missing or null retains the live value.
